notes.enhancement: Regular polish and gel polish are priced the same for artificial nails.
notes.kids: For children under 9. Regular polish can smudge or mix during kids' activities, so it has no warranty: please check your child's nails before leaving to make sure the color looks right. Thanks for understanding!
notes.pedicure: Add paraffin wax (+$10) or gel polish (+$15) to any pedicure.

policy.title: For our clients and our salon
items: Please let us know about any health concerns, including diabetes, before your service.
Prices are on our menu. Please confirm them with your nail tech before receiving services.
Please give us advance notice if you need to cancel your appointment.
Ask for the service you would like. If you need clarification, please talk to the salon manager.
We do not provide refunds on services, but we will resolve any issue with the service itself.
If you are unsatisfied with our service, please inform the salon manager.
We are not responsible for lost or stolen personal items or gift cards, or for damage to belongings.
We reserve the right to refuse or stop service for anyone who is rude.
policy.thanks: We want to thank you for your continued patronage! It is our pleasure to serve you.

faq.title: Good to know before your visit
faq.intro: Can’t find your answer? Call us at (919) 366-6435 or send us a message on social media.

items.a: Envy Nails Spa Of Wendell offers manicures, signature pedicures, nail enhancements (acrylic, powder gel, builder gel, Gel-X, BIAB), dipping powder, polish changes, custom nail art, waxing and a kids’ menu, in a relaxing and luxurious setting.

items.q: How do I book an appointment?
items.a: Book online any time on our booking page, or message us on social media. Call us directly at (919) 366-6435 if you need appointments for 3 or more people, can’t find your preferred time online, want your favorite nail tech or have special requests.
Yes, appointments and walk-ins are both welcome. Booking ahead guarantees your preferred time.
We’re at 2241 Treelight Way, Suite 102, Wendell, NC 27591. Search “nail salon Treelight Way” or “nail salon Wendell” on Google Maps to find us.
Monday to Thursday 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, Friday 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM, Saturday 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM and Sunday 11:30 AM – 5:00 PM.
Yes. Our kids’ menu (under 9) has manicures, pedicures, combos and polish changes, in regular or gel polish.
Yes, in any amount at the front desk: a perfect gift for birthdays, holidays and thank-yous.

items.q: Is there anything I should tell my nail tech?
items.a: Please let us know about any health concerns, including diabetes, before your service, and confirm the price of your service with your nail tech.
